reviews.text: Had my house power washed by Sprayaway. This was the first time the house was ever power washed. The difference was astonishing!  This was my childhood home, and my parents never thought to have this service done. I am SO happy and SO pleased that I did. Richie was punctual, polite, fairly priced!  I even had my patio and fence done. I would definitely recommend his services. In fact my sister loved his work on this house she is having hers done next
Hired Richie to power wash my moms whole house, windows, patio, deck, and balcony. He did an awesome thorough job. Price was very reasonable. Will hire him again each year!
Richie did an awesome job cleaning my gutters and power washing my patio and sidewalks.  He was extremely reliable, professional, and very neat about everything.  I highly recommend him.
